name: Loverse
source:
[i]From the very first moment, I felt [b]this[/b] was different. The loud music was ripping my ears apart, the lights almost driving me blind and that smell... A mixture of perfume and sweat, so overwhelmingly real that my gear could barely keep up.[/i]

[i]Everything in Loverse seemed perfectly genuine. But, nothing was in fact.[/i]

You logged into the enigmatic new server, Loverse, to find your long gone friend. But technology surpassed your wildest expectations. You tasted Lovers, savoured its essence, and fell in love with it.

And then you were ruthlessly cut off from that world.

Now, it's time to dive back into the wild VR realm where anything is possible. You must warn Alice, find the person who attacked you, and uncover the shocking truth behind Lovers. Fortunately, you won't be alone, as beautiful girls and real-world celebrities from the NSFW scene are here to help you. Along the way, you will encounter mysterious hackers, go on steamy dates, and dive deep into intense 18+ scenarios.

[from [url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/loverse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]從一開始我就知道，[b]這次[/b]不一樣。音樂震得我耳朵快裂開，燈光刺得我幾乎睜不開眼，還有那股氣味……香水混著汗水，真實得連我的裝置都快跟不上了。[/i]

[i]Loverse裡什麼都逼真得無懈可擊。但其實，沒有一樣是真的。[/i]

為了尋找失聯已久的朋友，你登入了神秘的新伺服器Loverse。沒想到，如今的技術遠遠超出了你最大膽的想像。你嚐到了這個世界的滋味，領略了它的妙處，也愛上了它。

然後，你和那個世界的連線就被無情地切斷了。

現在，是時候重新潛入這個什麼都可能發生的狂野虛擬實境世界了。你必須警告愛麗絲，找出襲擊你的人，揭開Loverse背後驚人的真相。好在你並非孤身一人，漂亮女孩和現實中成人娛樂界的名人都會助你一臂之力。一路上，你會遇到神秘駭客，赴火辣的約會，還會深入種種大膽的成人情境。
